metadata.street_name: Avinguda de la Riera de Cassoles

scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street with tall buildings and parked motorcycles along the sidewalk. The street has white lines painted on it and there are no cars visible. There are several buildings in the background, including a large tan building with many windows and balconies. The street is empty except for a few parked motorcycles. The sky is overcast.
scene_analysis.buildings: The large tan building has a mix of rectangular and arched windows and balconies. It has a flat roof and a small section of red brick on the right side. The building is made of concrete and has a modern look. There are several other buildings in the background, but they are not as prominent as the main building.
scene_analysis.materials: The street is paved with asphalt and has white lines painted on it. There are also some cobblestone pavers in the median. The street is relatively clean and well-maintained.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several parked motorcycles along the sidewalk. They are all black and have a sleek, sporty look. There are also some benches and trash cans along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are a few trees and bushes along the sidewalk, but they are sparse and not very dense. There are also some small plants and flowers in pots.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs along the street, including a parking sign, a stop sign, and a directional sign. They are all clear and easy to read.
scene_analysis.ground_surfaces: The ground is mostly smooth asphalt, but there are some cracks and potholes. There are also some cobblestone pavers in the median.
scene_analysis.spatial_enclosure: The street feels relatively open and wide, with plenty of space between the buildings. However, there are some narrow alleys and side streets that can be found off the main street.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: There are a few people visible in the distance, but they are not very active. Some are sitting on benches, while others are walking or standing.
scene_analysis.lighting_atmosphere: The lighting is soft and diffused, with a slight blue tint. The sun is shining through the clouds, casting a warm glow over the scene.
scene_analysis.as_resident: This area seems quiet and peaceful, with a few people going about their daily business. There are some shops and cafes along the street, but they are not very busy.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: This area is likely popular with tourists, given its historic architecture and lively atmosphere. There are several street performers and vendors along the street, and there are also some interesting landmarks and attractions nearby.
scene_analysis.as_student: This area is likely popular with students, given the presence of cafes and shops. There are also some young people hanging out in the area, chatting and laughing.
